email.subject: POAP KINGS is recruiting — war-focused clan, 5,000 trophy minimum
email.body:
POAP KINGS is a Clash Royale clan built around Clan Wars, real recognition, and a culture that most clans never bother to create.

We have 43 members, 18 players at 12,000+ trophies, 4 sitting at 14,000, and more than 154,000 career wins across the roster. Our recorded river race history shows consistent first-place weeks. We track all of it.

What makes us different: we issue POAPs for seasons and milestones, run a Free Pass Royale program for top war performers, and publish the clan data so serious players can see the depth of the roster.

We want players who show up for war, donate to clanmates, and want to be part of something intentional. Real life comes first, but when you're in, we notice.

Minimum 5,000 trophies. Come see what we're building at https://poapkings.com

reddit.title: POAP KINGS #J2RGCRVG | War-focused clan with real culture | [5000] trophies required | 43/50 members
reddit.body:
**POAP KINGS — #J2RGCRVG**

**Quick stats:**
- 43 members, 5,000 trophy minimum
- 18 players at 12,000+ trophies
- 4 members at 14,000 trophies
- 154K+ career wins across the roster
- Clan war trophies: 680 and climbing

**Who we are:**

POAP KINGS is a war-focused clan that also cares about building something with staying power. We track stats, recognize effort, and create actual clan memory — not just a Discord server with a trophy requirement.

We run a **Free Pass Royale program** for top war performers each season. We issue **POAPs** (collectible proof-of-attendance tokens) for seasons and milestones. We publish roster and Clan Wars data so people can see the depth of the clan before joining.

Our top players — OllieTurtle, Vijay, and Aaqib Javed — are all at 14,000 trophies. Our roster includes long-time accounts, deep collections, and active war players.

**What we're looking for:**
- Players who participate in Clan Wars when they can
- Consistent donators who support clanmates
- People who want to be part of a clan with identity, not just a leaderboard slot

Real life always comes first. But if you're going to play, we'd rather you play with people who notice.

Find us at https://poapkings.com or search the tag in-game.
